name: August Creek Farm
tagline: August Creek Farm — Arugula in Assumption, IL
description: August Creek Farm is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 1414 N 2400 East Rd., IL. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
